scope: Bounded the legacy const-vector GROUP setter before it copies caller-owned data.

behavior: setGroups refuses vectors above DRW_Dictionary::kMaxEntries before copying and marks the input rejected so a later writer plan cannot serialize stale groups.
In-limit vectors are copied into a temporary and swapped only after a successful copy; allocation failure marks input rejected and preserves the previous vector state.
A valid setter call or successful list adoption clears the rejected-input state. The independent planner refuses while that state remains set.
The focused control verifies ASCII/Binary refusal without changing the staged output stream, then applies corrected input and successfully replans on the same codec.

focused.coverage: List adoption cap plus const-vector no-copy refusal, staged-stream preservation and same-codec corrected replan in ASCII/Binary.

limitations: The count ceiling is internal and aligned with the dictionary entry limit; it is not a DXF format maximum or support claim.
The setter control proves admission, stream preservation and planner retry; it does not add native GROUP semantic qualification.
Other writer/import work bounds, allocation-failure injection across other builders, source lifetime and scoped concurrency remain open.
next: Continue the safety and caller-state audit on the other bounded staging and rollback paths.
